authority: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
checks: Composite DTM 1m covers about 99 percent of England
surface objects are removed from the DSM to make the terrain model
the 2022 composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
repeat surveys use the newest best-resolution data
resampling before merge uses bilinear interpolation
source surveys in the 2022 composite span 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
location-specific metadata catalogues identify which survey fed the composite
vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15cm RMSE
WMS service is published for the dataset
WCS service is published for numeric raster access
WMTS service is published for the dataset
an OGC API Features service is exposed for supporting metadata access
